label: Cellpose segment + measure
methodsText: Cells were segmented with Cellpose (model {model}; channels {cellChannels}; diameter {cellDiameter}; cell probability threshold {cellprobThreshold}), and shape and intensity measures were extracted for each cell from the {intensityValueName} image
purpose: Run Cellpose segmentation, then Measure labels
useWhen: The usual choice: labels alone leave nothing to gate, track or cluster
notWhen: Dim movie cells with no clear outline: use Optical flow segment + measure
Noisy or drifting images: fix them in Cleanup before tuning this
